title: Stealing and stealed - N’aix
flavor: In the dungeons of Devarque, a vengeful wizard lay in shackles, plotting his escape. He shared his cell with a gibbering creature known as N'aix, a thief cursed by the Vile Council with longevity, so that its life-sentence for theft and cozening might be as punishing as possible. N'aix retained no memory of its former life and no longer dreamt of escape. The wizard saw a perfect vessel for his plans, he wove a spell of Infestation and cast his life-force into N'aix's body, intending to compel N'aix to sacrifice itself in a frenzy of violence while the mage returned to his body and crept away unnoticed. But finally both of them failed. Until today the lifestealer, N'aix still wears the broken shackles as a warning that none may hold him, but on the inside remains a prisoner.
